scope: Analyze saved WIP48 ZIP only. No app edits, builds, imports, tests, archive construction, file deletion, split implementation or uploads. Only these requested audit deliverables were written.

basis.sourcePreviewParity: WIP48 deliberately contains newer Ford source with the older 315-record preview. It must not be labeled a verified matching pair.

recommendation: For continuing catalogue growth, use a source-checkpoint ZIP plus a separate complete portable-preview ZIP. Preserve byte-identical app payloads, original hero and all existing source, assets and QA. Reserve scene-reel archival only for a tiny immediate overage after durable recovery is verified.

splitMeasurements.sourceMemberRule: Every WIP48 member except roadmark/index.html and roadmark/index-b.html; retain source, data, original baselines/backups, runtime assets and all remaining QA
splitMeasurements.measurementQualification: Analytical member removal/addition accounting from the saved ZIP, including ASCII local/central headers and a new 22-byte end-of-central-directory record. Not a produced archive. New manifests, README text, Ford output and compression differences change final sizes. Removing only index.html while keeping its launcher in source would leave 17,274,011 bytes but a broken source-only launcher, so move the launcher with the preview.

standaloneEvidence.method: Static ZIP/content inspection only; no browser or runtime claim is made
standaloneEvidence.futureAssetWarning: Current media/approved-assets.json is empty. If approved photos or external resource paths are introduced later, repeat dependency verification; the present builder inlines chapter SVGs but its portable Image component can retain a local /media path.

proposedArtifactLayout.sourceContains: All baseline checkpoint members except the two generated root preview members, plus source-specific manifest and opening/restore guide
proposedArtifactLayout.extraction: Both ZIPs use the same roadmark/ root. Portable alone opens independently. For full restoration, merge both into one roadmark/ directory without nested roadmark/roadmark or automatically renamed sibling folders. Payload paths do not collide. Do not alter existing local files during packaging.
proposedArtifactLayout.unchangedExistingExclusions: Do not re-add generated public/index.html or public/index-b.html duplicates, runtime caches/binaries, local reports or already externally archived historical material. Keep all existing recovery references.

manifestRequirements: Shared schema version, pair ID and explicit artifact role; actual creation/build timestamps and verification status, including not release approved.
Enumerate every payload path, uncompressed byte length and SHA-256; preserve a deterministic source-payload manifest digest excluding packaging metadata.
Bind both manifests to that source-payload digest and the exact portable index.html digest. Record actual record/family counts, source checks, preview checks and any explicit mismatch.

List companion filename, extraction root, required-for purpose, generated aliases omitted and their exact regeneration method. Include external recovery archive identities/versions/checksums already verified.

Avoid cyclic archive hashes: per-archive manifests bind payload hashes; a separately saved pair receipt/recovery index records both completed ZIP hashes, byte sizes and actual Library IDs/versions only after saves succeed.
Use versioned names and preserve existing Library identities when appropriate. Do not invent a portable Library ID or imply that either proposed artifact has been saved.
Record that original Model Y hero, all nine reasons, source assets, original baseline/backups and current QA proofs are unchanged, supported by byte-level preservation checks.

previewOnly: Download and fully extract the portable-preview ZIP. Do not open HTML inside an archive viewer.
Open roadmark/index.html in a desktop browser with JavaScript enabled. index-b.html remains an optional alias preserving query parameters and anchors.

Local screens use the bundled data and art; external evidence links require internet. On file URLs, reporting is browser-local drafts where storage is supported. The durable review inbox needs the local service.
fullSourceRestore: Download matching source and preview archives and verify both against the saved pair receipt.
Extract/merge both roadmark/ roots into one directory; retain manifests and validate payload hashes before relying on recovery.
For development, use Node 22+ and pinned pnpm 11.19.0; install with pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, then pnpm dev. Installation may need internet.

To regenerate root/public preview aliases, run pnpm build:portable from roadmark/ after dependencies are installed. It writes index.html, index-b.html, public/index.html and public/index-b.html. pnpm build also invokes it. Regeneration from changed source may not reproduce a saved preview hash.

For a durable local review queue, use the matched root preview and run pnpm preview:review; open http://127.0.0.1:3013/index.html. The review screen is ?page=/review. This service binds loopback and keeps reports locally.
sourceOnly: Source ZIP alone supports development/build restoration after dependency installation, but cannot be described as containing an immediately openable portable preview.
Point source opening instructions to the companion ZIP or the regeneration command; avoid a dangling index-b launcher.

requiredBeforeFutureImplementation: Wait for the Ford portable build and current verification to finish; freeze matching source/preview inputs and measure the actual new files. WIP48 metrics use its older preview.
Prove source and portable counts/identities match; keep all current QA logs and proofs. Packaging alone does not add verification or release approval.

Compare the union of source/portable payload paths and hashes against the unsplit baseline, allowing only explicitly documented new packaging metadata and generated duplicate omissions already in force.
Verify original baseline/assets and Model Y hero preservation; confirm standalone opening and no missing resource loads using the normal authorized QA workflow.
Verify extraction/merge restoration, alias behavior and local review-service root-index dependency. Keep external evidence recovery independently versioned.
Measure both completed ZIPs below 20 MiB with a useful growth margin, then save and verify both artifacts before changing delivered instructions or claiming a durable split.

smallOverageAlternative.archiveProposal: Append scene-reel.html to a new verified version of the existing historical visual-QA archive, retaining its current 12 payload files; update its manifest, restore instructions and source checkpoint reference. Preserve local scene-reel.html. No archive update is authorized or performed here.
smallOverageAlternative.referenceWarning: qa/TEST_RESULTS.md explicitly cites scene-reel.html as the self-contained seven-scene visual evidence. If archived, make this historical evidence reference resolvable through the external recovery archive.
smallOverageAlternative.decisionBoundary: Reasonable only if the final measured overage plus new documentation fits within the actual 33,437-byte saving. It buys little future growth; prefer the two-artifact design if repeated catalogue expansion is expected.

warnings: Splitting changes download packaging, not the 41,219,581-byte current HTML load size, browser memory demand or mobile performance.
The current source-only estimate remains under 20 MiB by about 3.53 MiB, but future catalogue/evidence growth can consume that space. Measure per artifact at each checkpoint.
No original hero, app source, runtime asset, baseline or current QA image should be removed to achieve this split.
Existing WIP48 source/preview mismatch and ongoing verification must be stated until a matching verified pair is produced.
No new ZIP or Library file/version was created by this audit.
